description: Currently working on Cloudflare's Design Engineering team to enhance the dashboard experience and help evolve Kumo, Cloudflare's open-source React component library. My work bridges design and production, building high-fidelity, production-ready tools and interfaces for a dashboard used by millions of users.

As Project Manager for [[Time Table Selector|https://tts.niaefeup.pt]] (TTS), I lead the development and continuous improvement of an open-source React application that streamlines academic scheduling for university students. I coordinate contributors and translate student needs into product and engineering priorities.

Conducted UX research and data analysis for VAXPRED, a platform designed to predict vaccine efficacy. I analyzed user interactions and feedback and produced a technical UX report focused on the platform's usability and presentation of health information.
Contributed to open-source tools for the student community, including the core website (SvelteKit), the UNI mobile app (Flutter), and the Time Table Selector for University of Porto students (React).

Worked part-time on retail software for major clients, including SONAE. I developed PHP microservices for backend operations and maintained Android systems for in-store deployments.

Completed a full-time summer internship, continuing development on [[Dodia.pt|https://dodia.pt|/work/dodia]] and contributing to Significa's website. This was my first professional experience with Svelte, where I refined UI interactions and performance.

During my curricular internship, I built [[Dodia.pt|https://dodia.pt|/work/dodia]] from the ground up. I architected the full-stack application using Next.js and Drizzle ORM, delivering my first production application.
